description: Shows every quantity tier and price per piece for one 4OVER4 print product; use it when someone asks how the price changes with quantity or wants bulk pricing. For one exact configuration use configure_product. Requires the product slug. Returns each tier's total and per-piece price for the standard configuration and the best-value tier; size-priced products have no table. Customer phrases: "price breaks on postcards", "how much cheaper if I order 2500", "bulk pricing for flyers".
